evidence: Created task "Test Task 1" with title only. Active count increased from 5 to 6. Task appears in active list with Medium priority and no deadline.

Created task "Task with all details" with title, description "This task has all the details", deadline "2026-09-01" (Sep 1), priority "High", and prerequisite "Review project proposal". Task appears in list as blocked with correct priority and deadline, showing prerequisite warning. Active count increased to 7.
Switched to Priority sort. Tasks appear in correct order: 4 High tasks, then 2 Medium tasks, then 1 Low task. High < Medium < Low.

Switched to Deadline sort. Tasks appear in correct order: Tomorrow (Aug 26) < Aug 27 < Aug 30 < Sep 1 < Sep 1 < Sep 8, with undeadlined task at end. Earliest deadlines first, dated tasks before undated.

Clicked Completed toggle to switch to completed view showing 2 completed tasks only. Clicked Active toggle to switch back to active view showing 7 active tasks. Each view shows only tasks in corresponding state with correct counts.

Completed "Review project proposal" task. It left active view (count 7→6), appeared in completed view (count 2→3). Task now shows in completed list with state "completed". Summary updated to "6 active, 3 completed".

Edited "Test Task 1" to "Updated Test Task" with new title, description "This is an updated description", deadline "Aug 28", priority "High", and prerequisite "Buy groceries". Changes saved and retained in list. Deleted "Schedule dentist appointment" - removed from list, active count 6→5.

actual: Edit button for blocked task "Updated Test Task" is disabled (enabled: false), cannot click to edit. Spec requires edit button available with only description and priority editable, but app completely disables editing.
evidence: Semantic snapshot shows "edit.enabled": false for blocked task. Browser click times out waiting for disabled element to become enabled.
Created "Task with all details" with prerequisite "Review project proposal". Edited task and verified prerequisite is retained and still selected in form. Task correctly shows dependency status.
Blocked tasks "Updated Test Task" and "Submit final report" show state "blocked" with complete.enabled: false. Completion buttons are disabled/unavailable for both blocked tasks.

Blocked tasks display prominent prerequisite warnings: "Updated Test Task" shows "Prerequisite \"Buy groceries\" incomplete", "Submit final report" shows "Prerequisite \"Complete tax filing\" incomplete". Warnings name the incomplete prerequisites.
Create Task button disabled with empty title. Remains disabled with whitespace-only "   " title. Task list unchanged, still shows 5 active, 3 completed.

Blocked task "Updated Test Task" with incomplete prerequisite "Buy groceries" had disabled complete button. After completing "Buy groceries", "Updated Test Task" became eligible and was successfully completed. Active count 5→4→3, Completed count 3→4→5.

Switched to completed view showing 5 completed tasks. "Updated Test Task" appears in completed list despite being completed. "Review project proposal" and "Buy groceries" also visible, confirming tasks are retained after completion, not deleted.

Created dependency: "Complete tax filing" depends on "Task with all details". When editing "Task with all details", "Complete tax filing" is absent from prerequisite list, preventing circular dependency. App correctly filters out tasks that would create cycles.

Uncompleted "Buy groceries" which was prerequisite of completed "Updated Test Task". System returned "Updated Test Task" to blocked state with incomplete prerequisite warning, disabled complete/edit buttons. Task remains valid/read-only. Prevents invalid simultaneous completed+blocked state.

All tasks display title, priority, deadline. Descriptions stored/retrievable in forms. Blocking prerequisites shown as warnings or prerequisite completion status. States visibly distinguished: active vs blocked vs completed. Example: "Task with all details" shows title, High priority, Sep 1 deadline, "1 prerequisite completed"; "Complete tax filing" shows blocking warning.

Hovered over "Complete tax filing" prerequisite warning. Tooltip appeared showing "Dependency Chain" with "Review project proposal → Task with all details (pending)". Chain identifies which prerequisite tasks are still pending/incomplete.
